goal: Operate high-throughput checkout payment mutation service for global flash-sale events

threat_pre_mortem.description: Users double-click checkout button creating identical charges within a 10ms window
threat_pre_mortem.mitigation: Atomic idempotency key lock in distributed cache with 24h cached payload replay

threat_pre_mortem.description: 100k requests/sec attempt synchronous row update on a single inventory item counter
threat_pre_mortem.mitigation: 16-shard counter with uniform random write routing and periodic read rollups

threat_pre_mortem.description: Payment gateway latency surges to 30s during flash-sale peak exhausting socket pools
threat_pre_mortem.mitigation: Non-negotiable AbortSignal.timeout(3000ms) with exponential backoff and full jitter

verdict.rationale: All scale bottlenecks and malicious attack vectors are mitigated with bounded resources and zero-trust controls.
revisit_triggers: Payment gateway changes idempotency header semantics
